zh-CN.title: 探索者年度藏品焕新
items: 探索者活动换上月夜新主视觉，转发卡片同步使用完整横幅
五件年度藏品全面升级，可逐件查看头像框、双向气泡、变换背景与动态名片的实际效果
优化手机与深色模式展示，修复头像框装饰被裁切的问题

en.title: A new look for Explorer collectibles
items: A moonlit Explorer visual now carries through the event and full-width shared cards
Discover five refreshed collectibles with real avatar, chat bubble, shifting wallpaper and animated profile previews
Improved mobile and dark-mode layouts, with complete avatar-frame ornaments
